channel.title: mznews · UniMZ
channel.description: Mass spectrometry news and literature from UniMZ.

item.title: Literature Brief (October 28, 2026)
item.description: Cross-gradient LC-HRMS feature correspondence and cross-fragmentation spectral-library matching. / 跨梯度 LC-HRMS 特征对应与跨碎裂方式谱库匹配。

item.title: October 27, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Diagnostic-ion validation for glycopeptide searches, ambiguity-aware spatial pathways, and scalable mass spectrometry imaging. / 糖肽搜索的诊断离子验证、保留注释歧义的空间通路分析与大规模质谱成像计算。

item.title: Literature Brief — October 26, 2026
item.description: Topographic correction in 3D ToF-SIMS and transformation-guided metabolite annotation. / 三维 ToF-SIMS 形貌校正与转化规则驱动的代谢物注释。

item.title: Literature briefing: 25 October 2026
item.description: A benchmark examines how DIA search and quantitative-analysis choices interact, emphasizing accuracy and false-discovery control alongside identification depth. / DIA 搜索与定量分析的组合评测，把倍数变化准确性和假发现率控制与鉴定深度放在同一评价框架中。

item.title: October 24, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Reusable workflows for spatial proteomics, protein isoforms and cross-link-guided structural modeling. / 聚焦空间蛋白组、蛋白异构体及交联约束结构建模的可复用流程。

item.title: October 23, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: New spatial-proteomics and DIA workflow reports are visible, but their verification is incomplete. / 出现空间蛋白组与DIA流程新报告，但论文信息核验尚不完整。

item.title: October 22, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Benchmark design, proteomics outlier detection and reusable metabolomics integration. / 聚焦评测划分偏差、蛋白组异常检测与公共代谢组数据整合。

item.title: October 21, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: No additional computational mass spectrometry papers selected today. / 今天暂未选出新的质谱计算方法论文。

item.title: October 20, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Auditable omics reanalysis, single-cell graph clustering and local metabolomics workflows. / 可审计组学重分析、单细胞图聚类与本地代谢组工作流。

item.title: October 19, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: No additional computational mass spectrometry papers selected today. / 今天暂未选出新的质谱计算方法论文。

item.title: October 18, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Spectrum representations, spatial associations and uncertainty-aware analysis across proteomics and metabolomics. / 关注谱图表征、空间关联，以及蛋白组和代谢组分析中的不确定性。

item.title: Literature digest · October 17, 2026
item.description: Today's papers examine spectral evidence for de novo candidate reranking and stricter validation of retention-time prediction. / 本日关注两种提高预测可信度的思路：以谱图证据重排从头测序候选，以及用严格的数据划分检验保留时间模型。

item.title: Literature digest · October 16, 2026
item.description: This edition focuses on continuous QC for large proteomics cohorts, quantitative benchmarks with defined microbial communities, and interactive downstream analysis. / 本期关注大规模蛋白组的持续质控、已知微生物群落的定量基准，以及交互式下游分析。

item.title: Literature digest · October 15, 2026
item.description: Today’s papers address reusable training data for proteomics and integrated analysis of mass cytometry. / 今天关注蛋白质组学训练数据的可复用性，以及质谱流式分析的统一工作流。

item.title: Literature digest · October 14, 2026
item.description: Today’s papers connect small-molecule spectral prediction, mobility-resolved peptide identification and transferable single-cell statistics. / 今天关注小分子谱图预测、离子淌度肽段鉴定，以及可借鉴的单细胞统计方法。

item.title: Literature digest · October 13, 2026
item.description: Today’s focus is an LC–HRMS workflow connecting signal extraction, feature construction and putative metabolite annotation. / 今天关注将信号提取、特征构建与代谢物暂定注释连接起来的 LC–HRMS 软件。

item.title: Literature digest · October 12, 2026
item.description: Seven recent publications cover peptide mapping, modified-RNA annotation, reproducible metabolomics, ion-mobility imaging and multi-omics tools. / 七篇近期文献，聚焦肽段映射、修饰 RNA 注释、可复现代谢组分析、淌度成像及多组学工具。

item.title: Literature digest · October 11, 2026
item.description: Seven recent papers cover isotope prediction, structural modeling, formula and polymer-composition analysis, biologics data interpretation and acquisition integration. / 本日精选七篇近期方法文献，涵盖同位素预测、结构建模、分子式与聚合物组成辨识、生物药数据分析及采集集成。

item.title: Literature digest · October 10, 2026
item.description: Four recent papers examine proteomic representation learning, isotope-tracing feature pairing, DIA quantification benchmarks and isotope-guided metabolite discovery. / 四篇近期文献，关注蛋白质组表征学习、同位素示踪特征配对、DIA 定量基准与同位素引导的代谢物发现。

item.title: mznews is live
item.description: A new home for mass spectrometry news and literature, from UniMZ. / UniMZ 的质谱新闻与文献新空间。

item.title: Literature digest · October 7, 2026
item.description: Four recent papers on retention-time prediction, spectral representation learning, targeted MRM and proteomics analysis. / 四篇近期方法文献，涵盖保留时间预测、谱图表征学习、靶向 MRM 与蛋白质组学分析。
